comments: b2012d6c: ;Call the DE tag to initialize variables and then jump to BEGIN.
6b700050: ;Initialize variables and check if there is any existing subfile data.
28363088: ;If there is existing data, extract the 9th piece of the 0 node and store it in DE(1).
de99f8af: ;Clean up the %Z variable.
70a71b84: ;Write the prompt and question mark.
990933c5: ;Terminate the W subroutine.
80a83ea2: ;Write the current value (Y), handling line wrapping if necessary.

49fc2217: ;If the value is longer than 19 characters, the input variable (DV) is not defined or is defined as a free-text or MUMPS code input type, branch to the RW^DIR2 routine to handle reading the input.
6d5cd17e: ;If there is no input variable (DV) defined or it is defined as internal/pointer type and DE(DQ) exists (indicating a multiple), display '(No Editing)' and set X to null.
65ec89a2: ;Read the user's input (X) with a timeout (DTIME). If timed out, set DTOUT=U and X=U, and write a beep character.
5845b4dd: Exit this routine
9fc449cd: Increment the variable DQ (Data Queue) by 1
b814c20e: Transfer control to the line label specified by DQ
06b93e60: If DE(DQ) exists, transfer control to the RE (REcursor) label, otherwise execute W (Write), and TR (TRansfer control)
ef30163f: If X is empty, go to the A label unless DV contains 'R', then go to X, unless DV is null, then go to X if D is not positive, otherwise go to A
4dcc47f6: If X contains a '?', go to the QS (Query String) label. If X starts with '^', execute D (Disambiguate/Decode) and transfer control to ^DIE17
4de56f51: If X is '@', execute D and transfer control to Z^DIE2
6059a981: If X is a space, DV contains 'd', and DV does not contain 'P', and ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) exists, set X to the value at ^(DLB). If DV does not contain 'D' or 'S', write '  ' followed by X

26fc1ec8: If DV is null, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV does not contain 'S', go to P. If ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) exists, execute X:$D(^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1)) ^(12.1). Set % to the second piece of the DU string after splitting it by ';_X_:'. Set Y to X. If % is not empty and DIC("S") exists, execute DIC("S"). If DB(DQ) does not exist, write '  ' followed by %. Go to V.
4a8b7652: If a developer input code (DIC("S")) is present, execute it.
22c2d05e: Write the value of YS starting from the position of DG until the end if DB(DQ) is undefined. Set X to the part of YS before the first colon.

89e8c63d: If DV contains "P", set DIC to U_DU and DIC(0) based on DB(DQ) and whether DV contains "'". If DLAYGO is specified, set it. If DV does not contain "*", call ^DIC, set X to Y, and set DIC to DIE. Exit if X is negative.
3f6847fc: If DV does not contain "N", call routine D. If the length of the decimal part of X is greater than 24, remove X. Go to Z.

eaf8f9e1: If the second piece of DV (delimited by comma) is truthy, X contains a decimal point, and the fifth piece of DQ(DQ) (delimited by U) does not start with "$", then process X to remove leading and trailing zeroes from the decimal portion. If the decimal portion is empty and X contains a decimal point, convert X to a number.
a23b425b: Naked reference to kill variable YS and jump to indirection of label 'X' concatenated with DQ.
fa9fa75d: Kill DIC('S'), DLAYGO. If X is defined and not up-arrow, put X in DG(DW). If DV contains 'd', set ^DISV(DUZ,'DIE',DLB)=X. Go to label A.
14eee525: Write bell and '??'. If DB(DQ) is defined, go to label Z^DIE17.
4d43d09f: Set X='?BAD'.
d9c91de2: Set DZ=X. Execute label D, then label QQ^DIEQ. Go to label B.
9c54829b: Set D=DIFLD, and DQ(DQ)=DLB_U_DV_U_DU_U_DW_U_$P($T(@('X'_DQ)),' ',2,99). Quit.

ef6cb3b3: If DE(DQ) is undefined, execute label O, then go to label RD if 'X' doesn't contain '@', or label A if DV doesn't contain 'R' and X='@', or take the literal value of X if X='@'. Set X=Y and go to label N.
318447a7: Set DG=DV, Y=DE(DQ), X=DU. If DQ(DQ,2) is defined, execute DQ(DQ,2). Go to label RP.

59ecf076: If DG contains 'P' and the global node ^(0) of the global subscripted by X exists, set X to the value at ^(0),U,2. Go to RP if ^(Y,0) is undefined. Otherwise, set Y=$P(^(0),U), X=$P(^DD(X,.01,0),U,3), DG=$P(^(0),U,2) and repeat label R.

0d00035f: If DG contains 'V', Y is non-zero numeric, $P(Y,';',2) contains '(', and the global node @(U_$P(Y,';',2)_'0)') exists, set X to +$P(^(0),U,2). Go to RP if ^(+Y,0) is undefined. Otherwise, set Y=$P(^(0),U). If ^DD(+X,.01,0) exists, set DG=$P(^(0),U,2), X=$P(^(0),U,3) and repeat label R.
54ed1ebb: Parse the input X for a code subpart if it contains S or D.
d8c5ea55: If X is empty, set it to the default value for the field being edited, then branch based on other conditions.
0a0f303f: If the input transform does not contain I or #, go to the reader loop.
cac2b9b3: Perform input transform and go to reader loop if X is defined, else go to prompt loop.
47185e76: Exit the routine.
b8643432: Initialize variables for the editing session.
0250187c: Set up variables for editing the PRIMARY PHYSICIAN field (.09) and call the relevant routines.
4d64599e: Set DU to the root of the VA(200 global
ba24a54c: Set X to the value of DGJT1PH
8323f27d: Copy the value of X to Y
0c12c32c: If X is not empty, set DB(DQ)=1, and if DV is type INPUT TRANSFORM (I) or POINTER (P), execute the INPUT TRANSFORM code. If X is empty after the transform, quit.
64b6dee5: If X is not empty and the RD node exists, go to the Z label
717d9da4: Quit the X1 label
498f8aa2: If DG is defined and has more than 9 nodes, execute the FORM-ONLY FIELDS code, then go to ^DGJXA7
